description: This file defines an interface IGrainState<T> for managing grain state, and a concrete implementation GrainState<T> including features like state storage, ETag for concurrency, and existence tracking, primarily used within the Orleans framework for virtual actors.

classes.description: A sealed class implementing IGrainState<T>, representing the state of a grain with serialization support and constructors for initialization.
